## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] When speculative verification achieves an acceptance rate greater than 60%, end-to-end token generation throughput increases by 25% to 45% on memory-bandwidth-constrained devices. (high confidence) — https://huggingface.co/Qwen · keywords: Multi-Token Prediction Speculative Verification and Draft Amortization · also: https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Speculative decoding amortizes parameter weight memory loading across K candidate tokens by evaluating candidate sequences as a small parallel GEMM batch instead of K sequential GEMV reads. (high confidence) — https://huggingface.co/Qwen · keywords: Multi-Token Prediction Speculative Verification and Draft Amortization · also: https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp
